label: Sources at a port
subgoals: List the operands each port reads across all its operations
Count the distinct sources per port
Size the port's multiplexer by that count

label: Counting two-input multiplexer equivalents
subgoals: Subtract one from each port's source count
Sum over all ports of the unit
Multiply by the bit width to estimate real area

label: Using commutativity
subgoals: List the source sets of both ports as written
Swap operands of commutative operations to align repeated sources on one port
Recount the two-input multiplexers after the swaps
